mobile2_00.comment: Verified on the official telecelfaso.bf page (HTTP 200, rendered text). The closest 30-day monthly tier to 10 GB is 7.5 Go at 5,250 FCFA (USD 9.18 at 571.81 FCFA/USD). The next tier is 15 Go at 10,000 FCFA (USD 17.49). The earlier 5 Go / 6,000 FCFA figure is not on the official page. The night bundles (2 Go and 4 Go, 525 and 1,050 FCFA) are time-limited, so they are excluded; the page text says 7 days validity while the table says 30 days. The page heading reads '4G illimitée dès 100 FCFA', but no such bundle appears in the rendered body, so no unlimited offer is confirmed. The 'telecel.bf' domain does not resolve; the official domain is telecelfaso.bf.
